events.title: This Moment: Highlights from the White Rabbit Collection
events.description: Explore an extraordinary exhibition of bold, experimental 21st-century Chinese art from the White Rabbit Collection, addressing global themes through mesmerising light installations, powerful video art, and large-scale sculpture.

events.title: HOTA Markets
events.datetime: Sun 29 Jun & Sun 5 Jul, 6:00 AM – 11:30 AM
events.description: Discover one of the Gold Coast's most vibrant community markets, held every Sunday morning, offering a celebration of independent local producers, artists, and lifestyle goods.

events.title: Carrara Markets Car Boot Sale
events.datetime: Sun 29 Jun & Sun 5 Jul, 7:00 AM – 10:00 AM
events.description: Embark on a treasure hunt at Carrara Markets' famous Sunday morning car boot sale, featuring preloved fashion, books, homewares, tools, and bric-a-brac from local sellers.

events.title: Alan Fletcher + Riley Catherall Live
events.description: Experience an intimate live performance by Alan Fletcher and Riley Catherall at Mo's Desert Clubhouse, a local venue known for its indie/alternative and community music scene.

events.title: Gold Coast Chamber Orchestra Performance
events.description: Enjoy an intimate chamber music performance by the Gold Coast Chamber Orchestra, celebrating the lyrical beauty and rich colours of French and Russian musical traditions.

events.title: Miami Marketta Street Food & Live Music
events.datetime: Wed 1 Jul – Sat 4 Jul, 5:00 PM onwards
events.description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of Miami Marketta, offering free entry to enjoy diverse street food and live music ranging from intimate gigs to laneway performances, comedy, and cabaret.

events.title: Miami Marketta Open Mic Night
events.description: Showcase your talent or support local artists at Miami Marketta's monthly Open Mic Night on the eclectic Cargo Stage, with performances kicking off from 6pm.

events.title: Gold Coast Toastmasters Weekly Meeting
events.description: Learn and practice public speaking in a supportive environment with Toastmasters, where members share insights and techniques to build confidence and leadership skills every Wednesday.

events.title: Meet the Author: Sarah Bailey
events.description: Join best-selling crime author Sarah Bailey for a discussion about her new novel Click, with opportunities to borrow or buy a signed copy, and a community meetup beforehand.

events.title: Gold Coast Active & Social Meetup
events.description: Connect with like-minded individuals through a wide range of community-focused social events and activities designed for interaction and making new friends.

events.title: Gold Coast Language Exchange & Social
events.description: Join a vibrant Gold Coast community for fun, social, and meaningful events, including language exchange meetups, BBQs, casual hangouts, and outdoor activities.

events.title: Velvet Jazz Night
events.description: Indulge in a sultry evening of live jazz at Mondrian Gold Coast, featuring acclaimed vocalist Ashleigh Denning with a five-piece band, welcomed with champagne on arrival.

events.title: Gold Coast Yoga Sessions
events.datetime: Tue 30 Jun (6:00 AM), Wed 1 Jul (12:15 PM, 5:30 PM, 7:00 PM)
events.description: Participate in grounded, community-focused yoga sessions offered by the Gold Coast Yoga Lifestyle Group, with multiple weekly timeslots designed for authentic wellness and movement.

events.title: Connect & Learn: All About Adult ADHD
events.description: Attend an intellectually grounded health talk by Dr. Limor Theedar focused on understanding adult ADHD, exploring psychology and neurodiversity for a thoughtful audience.

events.title: Clash of the Keys – Cassidy Rae & Jake Bristow
events.description: Enjoy a free, intimate piano performance event featuring local artists Cassidy Rae and Jake Bristow in 'Clash of the Keys', showcasing their musical talent.
